title: Iowa State-led team uses data and AI to design next-generation organic electronic materials
summary_en: Iowa State's Wenjie Xia is leading a team developing data-driven, materials-by-design approaches to discover organic electronic materials. The materials could be used for flexible electronics, wearable sensors, bioelectronics and other emerging technologies.
title_cn: Iowa State-led team uses data and AI to design next-generation organic electronic materials
